notes: The SMS parser now distinguishes a REFUND (money coming back from an earlier purchase) from unrelated income (salary, being paid back by a friend) - both used to become the same undifferentiated 'credited' transaction with no way to tell them apart. 'Spent This Month' still isn't reduced by refunds (that's unchanged - a deliberate choice, not an oversight, since redefining that number needs its own decision), but the AI chat can now correctly answer questions about how much came back to you as refunds vs. real new income.
